name: academic-humanizer
description: Refine academic prose by removing generic AI phrasing while preserving evidence strength, numbers, results, equations, and citations.

interface.shortDescription: Refine academic prose without changing evidence, numbers, equations, or citations.
interface.longDescription: Academic Humanizer edits papers, theses, rebuttals, and grant proposals for clearer, less formulaic academic writing. It preserves numbers, equations, citations, scholarly hedging, and claim-evidence strength, and can match an author's prior writing or a target venue.
defaultPrompt: Revise this Introduction; keep every number and citation unchanged.
Edit this manuscript for concise, evidence-bound academic prose.
Revise this proposal while preserving claim and evidence strength.
